Name: Bi-weekly Review
Purpose: Review existing ideas and work against the latest available knowledge.
Prompt: Use NotebookLM/available team context first. Identify meaningful changes, evidence gaps, decision points, follow-ups, and research requests. Do not treat missing information as proof of novelty.

Name: Review Evidence Gap
Purpose: Prioritize the few evidence gaps that matter for current decisions.
Prompt: For each gap, state affected idea/decision, why it matters, existing evidence, missing evidence, and whether targeted external research is justified.

Name: Review Synthesis
Purpose: Synthesize review findings into actionable next steps.
Prompt: Separate verified findings, inference, unresolved questions, research requests, and follow-ups. Keep the result concise and decision-oriented.

Name: Review to Knowledge Candidate
Purpose: Identify reusable knowledge from the bi-weekly review.
Prompt: Prepare Knowledge Candidates only for durable, evidence-backed findings that can benefit future R&D work. Human review is required before Knowledge Sheet write-back.

Name: Review Research Request
Purpose: Prepare a maintainer-facing external research request.
Prompt: State objective, decision, known context, exact evidence gap, requested scope, and stop condition. Keep research limited to what can change the decision.
